authority.authorized_now: Prepare these two proposal artifacts and independent review only; no research data changes.
approved_task_rules: Use a linguistic expansion valid in sentence usage; entity identification or name etymology alone is insufficient.

scope_definition.recommended_first_step: Approve stage A as the smallest next review tranche: retain all 16 pilot occurrence decisions, follow up five remaining occurrence/policy issues, and review 95 existing inventory hypotheses independently across those 16 types. Do not repeat accepted label judgments or blind answers.
scope_definition.staged_envelope: The CSV also makes subsequent established natural-dev and train natural-Wikipedia work concrete, conditional on scope/capacity approval. It is not a request to review the full queue.
scope_definition.occurrence_rule: Union of the unchanged 16 pilot IDs, all 62 established natural-dev proposals, and all 54 historical train wiki_natural occurrences; exclude historical test roles. Deduplicate by stable item ID.
scope_definition.inventory_rule: All existing inventory_proposed hypotheses for the 46 selected types, once per inventory ID; select by type association, never by accepting a sentence label. No new candidate is added.
scope_definition.stage_assignment: Occurrence: existing pilot, else established natural-dev, else train natural Wikipedia. Inventory: earliest stage containing its type; references in later stages do not add work units.
scope_definition.counting_rule: Occurrence IDs and inventory IDs are distinct units with different tasks. Count each ID once across all flags/stages; occurrence records exclude inventory adjudication. Eleven pilot carry-forward records require no new occurrence adjudication in this proposal. Related-ID references and per-risk overlaps are not additional units. Counts are not measured effort or approved benchmark sizes.

train_natural_wikipedia_scope_note.difference: The pilot stratum excluded two rows with existing scope proposals. This proposal envelope retains them for scope inspection, not benchmark inclusion; it does not add them to the 16-item pilot or override their existing flags.

timing.reason: No active-review duration was recorded. Timestamps and chat waiting time are not durations. No entire-queue multiplication or retrospective imputation. Future workload estimates require prospectively measured review/adjudication/inventory times and coverage of the chosen strata.

deferred_outside_csv.interpretation: Overlapping counts are remaining review-planning obligations, not authorized selections or benchmark approvals. A later train/dev inventory and critical-occurrence scope is still needed before freeze; this tranche cannot certify all train/dev data.
deferred_outside_csv.low_risk_knesset: No new sample selected. Shaked must approve fixed sampling scope/rule; existing clean verdicts do not prove present-task eligibility.
deferred_outside_csv.test: No test occurrence selected or semantically reviewed; no test sentence, label or candidate disclosed. Test effects below are copied aggregate diagnostics only.

aggregate_structural_implications.non_additivity: The three pilot exclusion proposals are not subtracted from split or document counts: TQ already has document/scope flags, the two numerical cases have different automated-flag coverage, and policies remain pending. aggregate_structural_implications.type_family_risk: Retaining raw prefixed forms does not prove base-family disjointness. A future context-independent type-family rule may reveal related forms across splits; do not merge types or move items now. Task-unseen does not imply unseen in pretraining.

author_validation.test_evidence_policy: Occurrence rows are gated on roles before payload access. Selected inventory hypotheses use independent candidate/source exports and selected non-test occurrence/type-review pointers; offered_by test payloads are not inspected or copied.
author_validation.whitespace_note: Initial standard CSV CRLF terminators triggered the repository whitespace check; the new proposal CSV was changed to LF and checked again. Existing files were not reformatted.

risk_counts_interpretation: Overlapping proposed inspection categories, not confirmed errors or unresolved judgments. A target category may describe a preserved accepted span; the linguistic-expansion category on every inventory row denotes the mandatory check, not evidence that every hypothesis is invalid. Existing source flags and scope proposals are retained separately in the CSV.
